title: Chapter 552
paragraphs: Chapter 552
Episode 145. Omen (21)
Octavia thought that even if Rosa personally led the Black Knights, she would not lose.
Assuming that they were defeated would be shocking, but this was the result of fighting Jin's party. Moreover, it wasn't because of her negligence.
She clearly put forth her best magic, but it was just insufficient to withstand the funeral pyres of Jin and Misha.
It's not over yet.
She wanted to get up again, shouting that, but her shattered body just convulsed.
"The captain has regained consciousness!"
"Captain, your orders...!"
The members of the Spectral Army guarding her were shouting urgently.
The battle on the ground reached its climax in an instant due to the collision between Jin and Misha's funeral pyre and Octavia's vision cut.

Both sides were squeezing out their remaining strength as soon as Octavia fell. The Spectral Army had to block the Mui people trying to seize the opportunity, and Jin's party had to somehow finish off Octavia.

Everyone was certain that there would be no next time if they could not completely cut off Octavia's breath now. They had to solidify their victory while the Spectral Army could not attack properly because they were protecting her.
Three members of the Spectral Army were killed, and six were injured to the point where they could not fight. On the other hand, all members of the Vamel Alliance were injured, but no one was killed.
This was the result of Runcandel's magic sword breaking Zipple's magic. Of course, it could never have happened if Jin was alone.
But Misha also poured out everything she had, like Octavia.
In the midst of the resumed battle, Misha could not fight. Even transforming back into a human to reduce the shock from the aftermath of the battle seemed to be difficult, and her breath was quick.
"Misha, are you okay?"
Jin was a little tired, but it wasn't enough to cause a major problem in the battle. Misha nodded her head and gave a faint smile.
"I thought it would disappear without a trace, but it seems I underestimated it."
"It's my fault."
"No, it's not. It's just another monster..."
With a cough, Misha spat out the clouded spirit energy and stared at the back of the Spectral Army.
She had expected that Jin's funeral pyre, with all her strength, would surely kill Octavia.
"Be careful, Jin. Octavia Zipple... she will probably get up again."
Jin had a feeling about that too.
Despite losing one eye, having severe reflux symptoms, and her body being shattered, it didn't seem like Octavia would end like this.
New light magic began to gather near the fallen Octavia. The glowing magic clung to Octavia's body, healing her.
The Spectral Army waited for Octavia's command.
Because they still had a choice. To retreat or continue fighting.
On the other hand, the Sword Emperor faction had no choice. Because they had nowhere to retreat to.
If the Spectral Army had determined that Octavia was completely incapacitated, they would have already chosen to retreat with her.
Octavia slowly got up. She seemed ready to collapse at any moment due to her staggering figure, but the light magic kept her balanced.
"There will be... no retreat. Continue the battle."
At her command, the magic of the Spectral Army became more aggressive.
Misha retreated to the rear ranks and hid in Murakan's veil, and the rest of the Mui people reformed their ranks around Jin.
Now, there were only twenty people in the Spectral Army who could fight. However, the moment Octavia began to recover, Jin's party had no choice but to face a more difficult battle than before.
"It seems you also have a long life, Octavia Zipple."
There were still remnants of the funeral pyre on the Bradamante. Jin released the remaining magic power to rekindle that flame.
It seemed to signal something. As soon as the sword began to burn, Jin's party and the Spectral Army lunged at each other with swords and staffs.
Everyone was exhausted and injured. No one on the battlefield could fully use their original skills.
Therefore, their battle was getting closer to the prototype of the act of 'fighting'. It was a primitive and brutal melee, often called a brawl.
Magicians pierced by swords and knights hit by magic screamed like beasts, not screams.
In particular, Jin and the Sword Saints' brute force stood out.
In such pure fighting, it was natural that Runcandel's sword, and the Sword of the Overlord made after it, shone the most.
Desperately.
Jin was moving towards Octavia. The Bradamante, dyed in black-blue, hit magic and shields every time it was swung, and because of the backlash, blood surged from his throat, but he did not stop.
Stopping meant the end. Since he had already entered the enemy's ranks, falling or stopping here meant death.
The same was true for his comrades who followed him into the enemy lines.
It was like crossing a sea where you couldn't turn back once you started swimming. The only thing that came when you stopped before reaching the end was cold death.
The risk of being dismembered and dying at any moment was approaching.
Even so, not a single Mui was afraid to throw themselves into that path. They simply moved forward, watching Jin's back, pushing back the enemies flying towards him, and trusting him.
"Why doesn't the 12th flagbearer fall...!"
"Damn it, does he still have energy after doing that to our captain!"
As always, the human named Jin Runcandel was incomprehensible to the wizards of Zipple.
How could he perform such miracles each time, why are they being pushed back when they are objectively in a superior position, what is this power.
When did he become such a formidable enemy...
Even as they desperately cast powerful magic, Jin's breakthrough speed showed no sign of slowing.
He'll stop this time, he'll back off a step this time, he'll fall this time...!
All their predictions were off. At one point, the magic of the Ghost Army directly struck Jin's chest, yet he showed no sign of taking any damage.
The magic seemed to pass through him like a ghost.
Wait, felt like passing through a ghost?
Damn it!
At that moment, the members of the Ghost Army had to realize a terrible fact.
They had once again been fooled by the trickery of Black Dragon Misha.
From the mid-breakthrough, what the Ghost Army had been attacking was not the real Jin. It was an illusion of Jin created by Misha's spirit before she retreated.
An illusion, unlike a spirit puppet, has no physical power, but it was enough to deceive the enemies who had lost their focus.
"Do you have enough energy to waste on illusions? I don't think so."
Jin said as he stabbed his sword into the abdomen of a member of the Ghost Army.
He had hidden himself among the swordsmen while the attack focused on the illusion. And the Ghost Army member he killed was the one guarding right in front of Octavia.
By then, Octavia was barely holding herself up in a highly combative state. But it was only better than right after being hit by a flare, she was still not ready to fight.
"Block him!"
Magic beams flew through the not yet fallen corpses of the Ghost Army. Jin barely turned his head and the beam just grazed his cheek.
There was no energy left to avoid the follow-up attack, but Swordman Ruyan stepped forward at an unbelievably fast speed to protect him.
Ruyan's wrist that entered his view was thin as a dried twig. Unbelievably thin for a warrior who had trained all his life.
The other swordsmen who followed were all as thin as her, the price of using the Emperor's Sword.
But as they became thinner, their swords became sharper. Like a flame bursting out just before it goes out.
There was no time to say thanks or exchange glances. Jin pushed further inward with the warriors behind him.
"Octavia Zipple!"
With a roar-!
The spirit energy and flames enveloping Bradamante intensified. Octavia was backstepping to avoid Jin's charging sword.
It is impossible for a person of her caliber to be backstepping so clumsily during a battle.
Even if she's a wizard, there are basic physical techniques to deal with warriors, and she never backstepped when dealing with warriors who were clearly superior to Jin.
Although it's a movement seen in an amateur fight, Octavia had no choice.
'If I had just one more minute to recover...!'
However, Jin couldn't cut her down in her exposed state.
The Ghost Army was indeed the Ghost Army. While the swordsmen and their comrades were pushing them back with their lives, it was not enough to completely break down the last line of defense.
If Octavia had been in good shape, they wouldn't have been able to reach this point in the first place.
Feeling the wind of the blade passing by her nose, Octavia felt her whole body go cold with sweat.
'Now 55 seconds, 54... Damn it!'
That time felt unbearably long.
She felt that her subordinates wouldn't be able to fully protect her in that time. It wasn't because the Ghost Army's abilities were lacking.
Jin was special in a way that could never be explained by simply being strong, great, or lucky...
Amidst the raging swordsmanship and magic, Jin always had one thing on his mind.
To cut.
He was executing the essence of the magic sword, something he had realized before he learned the first form of the Spirit Sword from his brothers.
He was armed with the will to cut at any cost.
That will managed to break out of the Ghost Army's encirclement and reached Octavia again.
The moment the black and blue sword, meant to cut her down, was raised to the sky, Octavia had to face a huge and dark emotion she had long forgotten.
Fear.
The fear of certain death if things continued this way.
"Gah, Ahhh!"
"Ugh!"
The moment the sword was swung down, Octavia and Jin screamed simultaneously.
A magic beam from the Ghost Army had hit Jin's back. His spirit armor blocked it, but the shock whitened his vision for a moment, and as a result, Bradamante couldn't split Octavia in half.
Swoosh-!
What Jin cut was Octavia's staff and the right hand holding it, which she had reflexively thrust out.
The black and blue flame stuck to the cut surface, preventing the light from healing, and the severed hand turned to ashes and flew away in an instant.
Pushing any further would be too much.
'First, I need to regroup with my allies and seize another opportunity. After all, Octavia's recovery will be delayed, so we can win...!'
If he proceeded further, he would not only endanger himself, but his allies would certainly die. Jin retreated, looking down at the fallen Octavia.
"You once claimed to fear nothing in this world, so how do you feel now, Octavia Zipple? Is your arrogant heart still the same?"
In her life, there was only one moment more humiliating and shameful than today, the day she faced Chiron.
Whether it was due to the participation of the Black Dragon Misha, the struggle of the swordsmen and their comrades that exceeded expectations, or Jin's uniqueness.
For whatever reason, Octavia had essentially already lost in the terrestrial battle. Despite possessing an absolute advantage, she had been utterly defeated. Octavia herself had to admit this.
"This fight is your victory, Jin Runcandel."
"It's not over yet since I haven't cut you down. And it would be nice if you corrected that to the victory of the Vamel Alliance and the Imperial Sword City. You won't be able to if you die...."
At that moment,
Suddenly, Jin felt a dreadful energy starting from the sky, something he had only experienced once a long time ago. His comrades also felt the same energy that Jin had perceived.
Octavia spoke in a calm voice.
"However, my defeat does not necessarily mean the defeat of Zipple... It must be unfortunate for you."
What the party was feeling was, in the end, the energy of the Demon God Stone that had finally been activated.
